# origincloud_kms_public_key (Data Source)

A signing key version's public key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The public key's resource name: its version's, followed by `/publicKey`.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The algorithm the key version signs with. One of `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT`, `SIGN_ECDSA_P256_SHA256`, `SIGN_ED25519`.
- `id` (String) The public key's full resource name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/versions/{version}/publicKey`: what an argument that refers to the public key takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `pem` (String) The public key as a PEM-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo, which OpenSSL and most libraries read.
